:::{#cor-gamma-mean}
#### Mean of the gamma distribution

If $T \sim \dGamf{\shape, \rate}$,
then $\E{T} = \shape / \rate$.

:::

::: proof

By @thm-gamma-moments with $k = 1$:

$$
\ba
\E{T}
&= \frac{\gammafn(\shape + 1)}{\gammafn(\shape) \, \rate}
&& (\text{moment formula with } k = 1) \\
&= \frac{\shape \, \gammafn(\shape)}{\gammafn(\shape) \, \rate}
&& (\gammafn(\shape + 1) = \shape \, \gammafn(\shape)) \\
&= \frac{\shape}{\rate}
&& (\text{cancel } \gammafn(\shape))
\ea
$$

:::
